text:
Ana: Quick sync — triage for deferred fixes from the July postmortems. Who can confirm ownership for the 3 recurring cache eviction issues?
Mike: I can take the global LRU eviction one (svc-cache). I'll add owner in the tracker.
Sophia: I picked up the namespace collision fix in router-cache. Will prototype a guarded eviction flag this week.
Jordan: I can handle the multi-tenant telemetry gap (missing evict metrics). ETA end of next week.
Priya: Are we consolidating these into a single remediation epic? Recommend grouping under EPIC-447.
Ana: yes please. Can owners paste ticket ids here. We'll set deadlines and weekly check-ins.
Mike: svc-cache: INC-9812 -> PR ready, needs perf test in staging. target deploy 2024-08-12.
Sophia: router-cache: TKT-3345 -> spike done, will open PR tomorrow. target deploy 2024-08-15.
Jordan: telemetry: DATA-221 -> need schema approval. pinging @Priya for data owner review.
Priya: ACK, reviewing schema today. if no blockers, approval in 24h.
OncallBot: Reminder: weekly reliability review tomorrow 09:00 PDT — add any deferred fixes to the agenda: https://cal.example.com/weekly-reviews
Ana: If all owners can add "remediation-owner" and "target-date" labels to their tickets, I'll generate the action tracker export.
Mike: done (labels added).
Sophia: added labels and linked to EPIC.
Jordan: labels + linked. also added test plan note.
Priya: schema approval pushed as comment. small naming nit; cc @Sophia for router changes.
Ana: Good. For recurring pattern analysis — does anyone have hypotheses beyond eviction race and telemetry gaps? eg. config drift or autoscaler churn?
Mike: Observed config drift on canaries last month; I suspect deployment hooks sometimes skip cache warmup.
Sophia: We should add a canary warmup step to the deployment job. I'll draft a patch.
Ana: Action items recap: owners (Mike/Sophia/Jordan), tickets (INC-9812/TKT-3345/DATA-221), EPIC EPIC-447, labels added, deploy targets noted. Weekly check-in tomorrow 09:00. I'll run synthesis and follow up with timelines.
Jordan: will add QA checklist and assign a reviewer from prod-safety.
Mike: Can someone add the perf baseline numbers? I want to ensure no regressions.
Priya: I'll attach metrics snapshot once schema approval done.
Ana: Thanks. If any blocker slips, escalate here or DM me. :thumbsup:
OncallBot: Incident trend digest uploaded: https://s3.example.com/reports/incident-trends-2024-07.pdf (size 1.2MB)
Sophia: One more — can we set automatic re-open of tickets if similar signal reappears within 7 days? signal: cache.eviction.error rate.
Ana: Good idea. I'll propose that in the playbook PR.
Mike: closing loop — I'll post a staging perf run result in #eng-runtime after tests.
